newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France office blasted by bomb in Nice.
newsitem.headline: Air France office blasted by bomb in Nice.

text.p: A powerful bomb ripped though the offices of the national carrier Air France in this French Riveria capital, causing extensive damage but no casualties, police said on Wednesday.

There was no immediate indication as to who was responsible, but police said the most likely suspects were Corsican separatists who have made several such attacks in southern France since a recent police crackdown against them.
Algerian Moslem fundamentalists who carried out a wave of bombings in France in 1995 were not immediately suspected.
The blast late on Tuessday virtually wrecked the airline office in central Nice and seriously damaged several neighbouring shops and parked cars, police said.
Several similar attacks have recently targetted the airline's offices both in Corsica and on the French mainland.
Since 1990, a dozen bombings attributed to Corsican separatists have hit Nice, including a blast at the inland revenue offices which injured three people in December 1992.
